messages.author: be7569f5cd63fd1b
messages.subject: Methylation  object shows the same result for every read context (CPG, CHH, CHG) when calculated the methyl difference
parts:
Hello,

1) I have created the following methylation object for methylation for sorted bam files using the processBismarkAln function for my control and text samples. below is the link for RDS file for it.

Methylation object

When I am changing the read.context to the different context, but still  I am getting the same output in all three contexts. 

This the file for it:
Methylation difference
I am using this command for tileMethylCounts
#tiles=tileMethylCounts(myobj,win.size=100,step.size=50)
meth = unite(tiles, destrand = FALSE)
myDiff = calculateDiffMeth(meth)


# get hyper methylated bases

myDiff25p.hyper=getMethylDiff(myDiff,difference=25,qvalue=0.01,type="hyper")
#View(myDiff)

# get hypo methylated bases
myDiff25p.hypo=getMethylDiff(myDiff,difference=25,qvalue=0.01,type="hypo")
#
#
# get all differentially methylated bases
myDiff25p=getMethylDiff(myDiff,difference=25,qvalue=0.01)


Please help. I am not sure where I am wrong.

Thank you 
Regards
Sap

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Methylation object shows the same result for every read context (CPG, CHH, CHG) when calculated the methyl difference
parts:
non-CpG contexts seem more methylated than I would expect, in mammalians non-CpG methylation is rare, I don't know which species is this and that doesn't matter so much.

This effect could be species specific thing or BS conversion efficiency problem. If the latter, methylation levels from different contexts might be correlated when you are looking at tiles. 

I don't think this is a problem with methylKit. 

Best,
Altuna

parts:
Hello,

I had the same problem working on methylKit 1.12.0 on Linux, the output of the function getMethylDiff was the same for the 3 context when the argument save.db=FALSE was used. The bug was fixed once I used save.db=TRUE (although some white spaces are inserted around the argument prefix="text" used). This bug is apparently absent in version 1.11.1 (tested on Windows). I am therefore not sure if the problem comes from the OS or the methylKit version used.

Best,
Johan
